newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 10.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 10.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The National Bank of Hungary confirmed that fake 5,000 forint bills are in circulation.
- Rapidly changing tax regulations cause difficulties for both courts and the Tax Office.
- Government forecasts say economic growth could reach five percent by the turn of the century while inflation could sink below 10 percent.
- The Hague court case in the Gabcikovo dam has reached its last stage.
- The Industry and Trade Ministry had initiated a programme to encourage domestic companies to beome subcontractors for multinationals present in Hungary.
- TV concession bids are submitted today.
